The report does not state a reference area or country, so dataflow coverage cannot include a geographic code.
The dataflow agency is based on the named publishing institution in the report; no separate SDMX maintenance-agency registration was supplied.

Exact SDMX 2.0 structure-message details and registry publication status for these dataflows are not confirmed from supplied external evidence.

dataflows.name: Consumer price index by consumption division
dataflows.description: Logical dataset for the monthly fixed-basket consumer price index classified by consumption division, with observations measuring price change relative to 2023=100.
dataflows.coverage: Monthly CPI observations by consumption division; report evidence covers months 2025-01 to 2025-04 and divisions shown as Food and non-alcoholic beverages, Housing and utilities, and Transport. Geographic coverage is not stated.
dataflows.evidence_quote: The CPI is a monthly fixed-basket index classified by consumption division.

dataflows.name: Mean household spending by residence and expenditure quintile
dataflows.description: Logical dataset for annual survey estimates of mean monthly consumption expenditure per household by residence and expenditure quintile.
dataflows.coverage: Annual household spending survey estimates by residence and expenditure quintile; report evidence covers year 2024, Urban and Rural residence, and Lowest quintile and Highest quintile categories. Geographic coverage is not stated.

Household spending is an annual survey estimate by residence and expenditure quintile and is
